market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Estimates vary sharply by methodology: $100.12B (2024) to $396.18B by 2035 (13.32%/yr) per one source; $251.24B (2025) to $515.92B by 2034 (8.37%/yr) per another.
globalCompetitors: not applicable at global scale for a small exporter — see peers[] for Indian comparables
market.domesticSlice: India herbal medicine market: $7.26B (2025) to $30.0B by 2035 (15.2%/yr); India medicinal plant-extracts market specifically: $955.39M (2025) to $2,068.0M by 2035 (8.0%/yr). India's Ayush exports doubled over the past decade to $2.16B, reaching 150 countries; raw herbs and extracts account for 60-70% of current export volume.

structureFacts: AYUSH Ministry's International Cooperation Scheme and Voluntary Certification Scheme for Medicinal Plants Produce (VCSMPP) support exporter credibility/certification
In FY2023-24, US imports of Ayush/herbal products reached $183.31M, Germany $62.64M, Italy $36.20M — the demand concentration is real and specific, not evenly distributed
